features: NEW UPDATE 6 IN 1 HAIR DRYER BRUSH: The hair dryer brush set new with diffuser for women comes with 6 interchangeable brush attachments that make 1*narrow hairdryer head, 2* left/right direction air hair wrapping curling iron, 1*hair straightener brush, 1* volumizing brush, 1*hair dryer with diffuser. 3 TEMPERATURE SETTING FOR ALL HAIR: 120°F- 220°F / 50°C- 105°C, Brush blow dryer supplies 1000W of power, 3 temperature settings to adjust the heat, suitable for different hair types. 1. NEGATIVE IONIC HOT AIR BRUSH: The automatic hair curler releases thousands of negative ion airflows to care for your hair during drying. Hair dryer brush blow dryer brush in one adopts a ceramic coating process to smooth the static frizz effectively. Curling brush allow you get luxury salon hair care without heat damage, increase your hair shinny & healthy.

TIPS FOR USTING AIR CURLER AIR STYLER: 1. Hold a small section of hair about 10cm from the tips. 2. Bring the hair toward the barrel, hair will begin to wrap. 3. Must be Start wrap from the hair tips. 4. Create tension and bring towards your head. 5. Hold in place for 15s. 6. Turn off and release. The usage of hot air curling sticks is different from the regular curling sticks. If you are confused during use, please contact us and we will provide you with professional service support.

SAFETY & CONVENIENCE: Our designed with your safety in mind, this Hair brush blow dryer features a standard US ALCI safety plug with auto leakage protection. The handle is designed to withstand high temperatures, ensuring durability and peace of mind. Additionally, we recommend using anti-scalding gloves when changing the removable blow head to prevent burns. The initial use may produce a slight odor, which is normal and will dissipate quickly.

features: Well-Crafted and High-Quality: Our 8X10 rug is made from high-quality chenille materials, ensuring durability and resistance to wear, fading, stains, and shedding. Featuring a symmetrical central design with intricate plant elements like flowers, leaves, and vines, the large area rug offers rich layers of color and vintage aesthetics for a timeless look. While natural light gives the most accurate color, slight variations may occur due to environmental factors during printing

Machine Washable and Easy-Care:Washable area rug surfaces are stain-resistant and easy to clean. Beverage stains can be blotted with a rag, and daily dust can be cleaned with a vacuum. For deep cleaning, simply wash the boho rug in the washing machine. Note: For 8x10 washable rug, we recommend using a washer with ≥5.0 cu ft capacity (or a commercial machine) to ensure cleaning

Nonslip and Pet-Kid Friendly: Our washable rugs feature a high-quality nonslip rubber backing , providing a secure grip to prevent slipping and shifting. The enhanced rubber bottom ensures excellent traction for the kids and pets. It also resists trapping pet fur, keeping vintage rug clean, and odor-free, making it perfect for homes with children and pets

Slim and Multifunctional Design: Our room rug features a slim, a 3mm low pile design that allows for easy door movement and smooth placement. Its ultra-thin structure offers both style and practicality, whether placed in the bedroom, living room, dining room, kids' room, nursery, playroom, and office

Wrinkle Removal Guide: 1. Lay indoor rug flat for 3-5 days to let the creases relax naturally. 2. Reverse fold the rug and leave it for a few days to smooth out wrinkles. 3. Place heavy objects on the creases to flatten them. 4.Use a hairdryer or steamer. When ironing both sides of the non slip rug, always place a thin cloth between the iron and the rug, especially on the back side, to prevent damage. Enjoy your boho area rugs
